summaries.summary: The document describes a study analyzing tweets from 300 brands in a random week in June 2011, which yielded about 246,000 conversations. Insights were derived from data-mining these brand-related conversations, which included spontaneous conversations about brands and content shared by brands. The study also provides insights into what people share on social media, such as experiences with products, offline touchpoints, competitions, free content, collaboration, lifestyle, positive messages, news, advertising, social media news, and employee stories. A sidebar offers advice on content production and highlights that only 10% of Facebook fan page comments are negative.
key_facts: The study was conducted in June 2011
Only 10% of Facebook fan page comments are negative
visible_text: In this instance, we selected a random week in June 2011 and analysed the tweets for 300 brands. This gave us about 246,000 conversations.
